title: Analytics & Tags
name: Analytics
description: Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 with a cookie consent banner (Google Consent Mode v2).
author: ImpressPages community

options.label: Google Tag Manager container ID
options.name: gtmId
options.note: Looks like GTM-XXXXXXX. Leave empty if you don't use Tag Manager.

options.label: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID
options.name: ga4Id
options.note: Looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX. Leave empty if GA4 is set up inside Tag Manager, so visits aren't counted twice.

options.label: Show cookie consent banner
options.name: consentBanner
options.note: Tracking stays off until a visitor accepts (Google Consent Mode v2).

options.label: Banner text
options.name: consentText
options.default: We use cookies to understand how visitors use this site, so we can improve it.

options.label: Privacy policy URL
options.name: privacyUrl
options.note: Optional. Shown as a link in the banner.
